tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen. Warm stone in light, near-black slate in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, inputs, sheets and the bottom navigation.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Inset areas: segmented-control track, badges, row hover, skeleton base.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Pressed state of rows and secondary buttons; skeleton shimmer highlight.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between cards and rows. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Dividers that must stay visible on surface-2, and secondary button outlines.

tokens.name: border-input
tokens.usage: Outline of text inputs, selects and checkboxes on surface: 3.7:1 light, 5.0:1 dark (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text and titles on bg, surface and surface-2: 14.5:1 or more in both themes.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (subtitles, meta lines, captions) on bg, surface and surface-2: 5.1:1 light, 6.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders and inactive icons only; 3.3:1 light, so never for text that must be read.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one primary action per screen, selection, active navigation, links and the focus ring. 5.2:1 or more on bg, surface and surface-2 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed primary buttons; text on accent-soft (7.3:1 light, 8.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows and chips, moderate evidence badges, the anatomy highlight card.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill: 6.0:1 light, 8.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline text links; same as accent so there is one interactive colour.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every focusable element: 5.2:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Information notes, the 'Conflicting' evidence grade, second chart series. 5.6:1 or more on bg and surface.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info notes and the caution box; info text on it is 5.3:1 light, 7.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Things that need Mika soon: planned sessions, a backup that is due, unsaved changes. Never for errors.

tokens.name: attention-soft
tokens.usage: Background of attention banners and the 'Planned' tag; attention text on it is 5.3:1 light, 6.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations: saved, imported, session done. Always paired with a check icon and a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success toasts and the 'Done' tag; success text on it is 4.9:1 light, 7.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, errors and safety warnings. Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error messages and the safety card band; danger text on it is 4.9:1 light, 6.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: anatomy
tokens.usage: Muscle red. Reserved for anatomy renders and muscle icons; never a UI state.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: Dark ground behind the body explorer and muscle renders, in both themes.

tokens.name: on-stage
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the stage (body explorer controls), both themes: 13:1 on stage.

tokens.name: on-stage-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the stage, both themes: 8.6:1 on stage.

tokens.name: on-stage-fill
tokens.usage: Resting fill of controls on the stage.

tokens.name: on-stage-line
tokens.usage: Outline of controls on the stage.

tokens.name: on-stage-active
tokens.usage: Selected control on the stage; text on it is stage-ink.

tokens.name: stage-ink
tokens.usage: Text on on-stage-active.

tokens.name: video-bg
tokens.usage: Letterbox behind embedded videos.

families.sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
families.mono: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the Home greeting.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Page titles in the page header.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Sub-headings inside a card, list group headers.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Needle across the lifted muscle only — never down toward the lung apex.
styles.usage: All running text, steps and form values. Never smaller for reading.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: List row titles, button labels, emphasis inside body.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Meta lines, subtitles, captions under images, field labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows, badges and tags. Short words only.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Measurements, dosages, ROM degrees and times wherever digits line up (tabular figures).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related items: chips, buttons in a row, title and subtitle.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List row gap between thumbnail and text; inner gap of fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Side gutter of every screen, card padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections (e.g. before a section heading).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap above the disclaimer and empty-state illustrations.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Bottom padding above the navigation bar.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, segmented thumbs, thumbnails, images inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, the body-explorer stage, hero cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, badges, tabs, icon buttons, the active navigation pill.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards and list groups.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Sticky bars, the bottom navigation, the selection card over the body.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs and toasts.

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of every touch target.

tokens.name: row-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of list rows with a thumbnail.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Bottom navigation height, before the safe-area inset.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size (1.8px stroke).

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons and chips.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum content width on tablets and desktop.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback (scale and colour).

tokens.name: duration-quick
tokens.usage: Hover, toggles, chips, checkmarks.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Disclosure open, tab and segmented indicator slides, page transitions.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Sheets and toasts entering.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Everything that enters or moves: decelerates into place.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Things leaving the screen: accelerates away, 70% of the enter duration.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Small confirmations only: a checkmark, a toggle thumb, the nav pill.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky headers and the SOAP jump bar.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Bottom navigation.

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above sheets.
